d/dx[exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x))]
= exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x)) + exp(x)*(cos(x) - sin(x))
= 2*exp(x)*cos(x)

Therefore,

<answer>exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x)) + C</answer>
